newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-B. Philp hopes for steady half yr div.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-B. Philp hopes for steady half yr div.

text.p: SYDNEY, Nov 11 9Reuter) - Burns Philp and Co Ltd chairman William Irvine said on Monday he hoped the food ingredients group would post an interim dividend comparable with the eight cents per share dividend paid for the first half of 1995/96.
Irvine told the annual general meeting he was also hopeful of a similar sized final dividend.
Burns Philp did not pay a final dividend in year ended June 30, 1996. It reported a net loss of A$61.8 million for the 1995/96 year, compared with a profit of A$115.1 million in 1994/95.

"I would personally hope that we would at least hold the interim payment with the previous comparable half and the same comment applies for the final payment (of 1995/96)," Irvine told the meeting, in response to a shareholder's question.

Earlier, in his chairman's address, Irvine said that despite the non-payment of a final dividend for 1995/96, the company's policy of paying out 65-75 percent of pre-abnormals net profit remained unchanged.
Burns Philp shares were one cent higher at A$1.96 at 12.30 p.m. (0140 GMT).
